style.text: Leave continuous matte near-black space around a single recognizable silhouette enclosing a miniature world. Preserve one or two identifying features.
Use indigo and blue-violet for depth, repeat rose-magenta inside and outside, and reserve peach-gold and near-white for peak light. Vary the thin cool rim.
Layer a broad atmospheric mass, a narrow detailed landmark band and broader foreground strokes. Resolve the local anchor and simplify its surroundings.
Model the carrier with thin directional strokes, use thicker opaque strokes inside, and orient broken foreground marks along the receiving surface. Confine flecks near the junction.
Keep most of the silhouette traceable. Dissolve one plausible junction so the same inner light continues outward and fades into black.

environment.text: Enclose {{inner_world}} within the silhouette, with {{landmark}} as its small focal landmark.

narrative.text: At {{junction}}, carry the inner light onto {{receiver}} and follow its direction.
